en.headline: 34 commits across two repos; 3 issues filed on OpenCode v2 compatibility
en.summary: On 2026-10-05, the user pushed **34 commits** across two repositories, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, 33 own commits reworked documentation and a small feature: the landing page was corrected per review and synced with v0.3.0 and the three skills, install docs clarified that the two one-liners are alternatives, `AGENTS`, `FILE_TREE`, `CHANGELOG`, and `PLAN` were synced with the change set, the README pair was restructured with install added and three stale eval files dropped, `claude-deep-research-skill` was recorded as MIT rather than unlicensed, `content_review` was updated to state that `--clean` accepts the readability pass, example-1 round 6 (repair attempt 1) was recorded in eval notes, and `test/` was marked retired in `.gitignore`. A single feature commit wove counter-evidence into the gate instead of labelling it. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 1 own commit fixed the daily report so a 0 commit badge is no longer coerced to 1, unified badge layout, and forced inline code in AI summaries; 12 additional automated commits were created by `github-actions[bot]`.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 34 次提交；就 OpenCode v2 兼容性新开 3 个 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-05 当天，用户在两个仓库共提交 **34 次**，无 PR、无 review、无 release。在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中，33 次本人提交主要围绕文档与一处小功能：按 review 修正 landing page 并与 v0.3.0 及三个 skills 同步，install 文档说明两条 one-liner 是二选一，`AGENTS`、`FILE_TREE`、`CHANGELOG`、`PLAN` 与本次变更集同步，README 对重排并新增 install、删除三个过期 eval 文件，`claude-deep-research-skill` 记录为 MIT 而非 unlicensed，`content_review` 中说明 `--clean` 接受 readability pass，eval 记录 example-1 round 6（repair attempt 1）细节，`.gitignore` 中标记 `test/` 已退役；另有一次功能提交将 counter-evidence 编织进 gate 而非仅打标签。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，1 次本人提交修复 daily 报告：Commits 角标 0 不再被兜底成 1，徽章排版统一，AI 摘要强制内联代码；另有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。issue 方面，用户新开 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills#180`，讨论 OpenCode V2 下 `SKILL.md` frontmatter 与运行时假设的兼容性；新开 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI#458`，修复 OpenCode v2 集成中的 skills 安装路径并新增 `mcp` target；并在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI#254` 上留言，指出 OpenCode 检测与 skill 安装路径指向 `~/.opencode`，而 OpenCode 实际使用 `~/.config/opencode`。
